bindings.dimensionSpecificObservation: PhoneArena's sustained graphics stress testing documents thermal throttling under load while reporting improved post-throttle GPU performance versus the prior generation.
materialCounterevidence: Sustained-load throttling still occurs; the source does not establish heat-free long gaming sessions.

bindings.dimensionSpecificObservation: PhoneArena's battery testing includes a 10h06 gaming result alongside browsing and video endurance, directly documenting gaming-session battery behavior.
Samsung specifies a Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with up to 120Hz refresh; PhoneArena also measured the panel's brightness and reviewed its outdoor/display behavior.
materialCounterevidence: The review notes the base S26 lacks the Ultra model's stronger anti-reflective treatment.

bindings.dimensionSpecificObservation: Samsung documents a three-camera rear system spanning main, ultrawide, and telephoto roles, and PhoneArena reviews the resulting multi-focal camera behavior.
Samsung specifies 3x optical zoom, 2x optical-quality zoom, and digital zoom up to 30x for the Galaxy S26.
PhoneArena directly reviews Galaxy S26 video capture and documents Horizon Lock stabilization as a video-focused feature.
PhoneArena reports measured browsing, video, and gaming endurance for the Galaxy S26, providing candidate-specific evidence for travel-day battery use.
PhoneArena describes the Galaxy S26 as comfortable to hold and specifically notes its compact ergonomics for smaller hands.
PhoneArena measured the Galaxy S26 wired charging behavior, including 59% after 30 minutes and a 1h16 full charge.
materialCounterevidence: The reviewed model remains limited to 25W wired charging.

bindings.dimensionSpecificObservation: PhoneArena's sustained graphics stress test directly records performance loss as the Galaxy S26 heats under prolonged load.
PhoneArena benchmarks the Galaxy S26 CPU and GPU and reports strong current-generation performance, including sustained graphics results after throttling.
The official triple-camera specification is paired with PhoneArena's candidate-specific photo review covering main, ultrawide, telephoto and processing behavior.
materialCounterevidence: The review reports warm processing and limitations relative to higher-end camera systems.

bindings.dimensionSpecificObservation: PhoneArena provides candidate-specific browsing, video, gaming and charging measurements rather than relying on battery capacity alone.
Samsung specifies a 120Hz Dynamic AMOLED 2X panel and PhoneArena independently measures and reviews its brightness and display quality.
materialCounterevidence: The review notes the absence of the Ultra's stronger anti-reflective screen treatment.

bindings.dimensionSpecificObservation: PhoneArena reviews One UI 8.5 on the Galaxy S26 as a feature-rich Samsung software surface with extensive device features.
